About

New York-born, London-based alt-jazz producer making joyous, hip-hop and soul-infused jazz that mixes hazy nostalgia with inventive production. Debut album Happiness passed 120 million streams. Second album Friends & Family features Mercury Prize-nominated collaborators.

Highlights

  • 120+ million streams on debut album Happiness
  • Collaborations with Moses Boyd and Joe Webb
  • Support from BBC 6 Music, Jazz FM, Clash, Wonderland and SZA
